REQUEST_FEATURE_SOURCE.formal_generator: src/scenario/scenario_generator.py::sample_tasks; one Bernoulli arrival draw per task vehicle and horizon, using configured task arrival probability
REQUEST_FEATURE_SOURCE.causality: forecast scenario rows at current origin; scenario horizons[0] is required to equal 0 in src/ppo_simple/interface.py; no realized future task rows used
REQUEST_FEATURE_SOURCE.candidate_formula: REQ_h = mean over S of sum(arrival[:, 0:h, :]); normalize by h * number_of_task_vehicles, then clip to [0,1]

WORKLOAD_FEATURE_SOURCE.field: cpu_cycles [S,H,T]; values are generated only for predicted arrivals and are zero otherwise
WORKLOAD_FEATURE_SOURCE.formal_generator: src/scenario/scenario_generator.py::sample_tasks; predicted service probabilities rho_hat choose the service; catalog mean_input_size and cycles_per_bit plus configured input/load jitter produce predicted input_size and cpu_cycles
WORKLOAD_FEATURE_SOURCE.fallback: none required; existing formal prediction artifact has finite CPU-cycle forecast arrays for all five horizons
WORKLOAD_FEATURE_SOURCE.candidate_formula: WORK_h = mean over S of sum(cpu_cycles[:, 0:h, :]); normalize by h * number_of_task_vehicles * per-request maximum CPU cycles, then clip to [0,1]

REQ_NORMALIZATION_DENOMINATOR.formula: h * T, with T=20 task_vehicle_ids in the existing formal prediction artifacts; at most one predicted arrival per task vehicle per slot
REQ_NORMALIZATION_DENOMINATOR.configuration_source: prediction_scenarios.npz task_vehicle_ids shape (20,) and sample_tasks arrival generation

WORK_NORMALIZATION_DENOMINATOR.formula: h * T * (input_size_max_kb * INPUT_SIZE_BITS_PER_KB * (1 + input_relative_jitter)) * cycles_per_bit_max * (1 + load_relative_jitter)
